CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
February 9, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Martin Nava to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term expiring in May 2021.
7.1 Reappointment to the Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 26, 2021.
8.1 Minutes of Jan. 26, 2021
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated February 9, 2021 in the total amount of $873,141.05.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-05, SPLASH! WATERSLIDE INSTALLATION PROJECT – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Western Water Features, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
8.3 CIP NO. 2018-05
8.4
LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE SERVICES FOR STREETS AND RIGHT OF WAY - REVIEW OF PROPOSALS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT TO BRIGHTVIEW LANDSCAPE SERVICES, INC. - It is recommended the City Council award the agreement to Brightview Landscape Services, Inc. for landscape maintenance services in the amount of $30,857,39 per month and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract, and any additional work and extensions to the contract on behalf of the City.
8.4 Landscape Mtc. Services
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-03, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 2 – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Doug Martin Contracting Company, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
8.5 CIP No. 2020-03
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-08, PHASE 6A, RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-08, Phase 6A, Residential Street Rehabilitation, to Onyx Paving Company, Inc. in the amount of $4,242,000; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost.
8.6 CIP No. 2018-08
8.7
AGREEMENT FOR PRINTING SERVICES FOR THE LA MIRADA LIVING CITY NEWSLETTER - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Printing Services for the La Mirada Living to the PM Group at a base price of $9,636.00 per quarterly brochure and $3,657.00 per newsletter totaling an estimated $58,223.34 annually; authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement ending on December 31, 2022 on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to renew the original contract for one additional two-year term; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total annual cost.
8.7 Agreement for Printing Services
8.8
CITY OF LA MIRADA FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS REPORT FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Financial Transactions Report for Fiscal Year 2019-20.
8.8 Financial Transactions Report
9.

9.1
ADOPTION OF URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. 715-U, INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 716, ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 21-04 ESTABLISHING ADMINISTRATIVE FEES FOR SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY PERMITS, AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 21-05 ESTABLISHING PERMITTING REQUIREMENTS AND REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO THE LOCATION AND INSTALLATION OF SMALL WIRELESS FACILITIES IN PUBLIC RIGHTS OF WAY - It is recommended the City Council adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 715-U by title only and waive further reading; conduct a public hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 21-04 approving administrative fees applicable to small wireless facility permits; introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 716, by title only, and waive further reading; and adopt Resolution No. 21-05 establishing a City-wide policy regarding permitting requirements and development standards for small wireless facilities.
9.1 Item Regarding Small Wireless Facilities
